描述_EN: fragment of canvas into which a square of tapestry is inserted. the square is composed of a central medallion (largely missing), surrounded by a purple circle, inscribed in a square; between the circle and the square, two trifoliate vine leaves at each corner. a large frame with a very regular vine scroll completes the composition.
